content.title: Implement --branch flag + update docs + agent awareness
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

The --branch flag was never actually committed despite parent mpe3pknd9j being marked done. This is a clean restart.

Three deliverables:
1. Implement --branch flag on agt init (library-developer)
2. Validate implementation (library-validator)
3. Update docs/markdown/ to document --branch (library-releaser)
4. Update agent expertise files to reference docs/ folder (cto)

Spec was already reviewed. Reviews mpe3pvr2yu and mpe3pv74lo contain feedback.

content.content:
Updated spec to incorporate critical review feedback from mpe3pvr2yu:

1. **Pointer file mechanism** (new  at repo root) — solves circular config discovery problem
2. **resolution.ts and tracker.ts scope** — added to modified files table, both need pointer-file-based discovery
3. **Slash rejection** — new AC8: branch names with  are rejected to avoid nested directories
4. **New pointer.ts module** — centralized read/write for the pointer file
5. **Multiple gitignore entries** — parameterized for multiple instances
6. **Breaking changes noted** — WORKTREE_BRANCH/WORKTREE_DIR → DEFAULT_BRANCH/DEFAULT_DIR (acceptable at 0.x)

Spec status changed from DRAFT to REVIEWED. Ready for implementation.

Validation (mpfm9ixr9i) complete. Two critical bugs found in implementation: (1) double directory creation when using --branch, (2) missing BRANCH_CONFLICT detection. Created fix issue mpfn4dkotn assigned to library-developer. Implementation issue mpfm9aff8v reopened. Validation re-run blocked on fix.
